title: Nested Flare package sizes
intent: Compare Flare animation and data package sizes with their core and specialized leaf-size composition in concentric rings.

ai.create: Aggregate Flare leaf sizes into animation and data families, then pass each ring through an independent native pie transform and render the resulting intervals as concentric radial-arc marks.
ai.maintain: Keep domain-specific family aggregation in the case while preserving independent declarative allocation, aligned family totals, ring order, flat lineage, semantic keys, the inter-ring gap, and responsive radii.
